# TypeScript File

## Summary
The FileDef specialization for TypeScript modules.
An instance is an uploaded realm file with card semantics: the binary lives at
the file URL while the card carries extracted metadata and renders with
format-aware templates.

## Shape
Extends `FileDef`. Adds `title`, `excerpt`, `content` and `lineCount`, filled on upload. Its
`previewComponent` is the syntax-highlighted source view, and it is the parent of
`GtsFileDef` — a `.gts` module is a TypeScript module with a template dialect,
so the identity, facts and preview are shared rather than duplicated.

Accepts: `.ts`

## Example
```ts
import { TsFileDef } from 'https://cardstack.com/base/ts-file-def';

@field attachment = linksTo(TsFileDef);
```
Instances are created by upload (`createFileDef` wires the type from the
MIME type). Live examples need uploaded fixtures — `Spec` has no field that
accepts a file today (`linkedExamples` is `linksToMany(CardDef)`, and
`FileDef` is a sibling of `CardDef`), so the example check stays open for
every file def until `fileExamples` lands.
